provenance.review: machine-checked by lab.tools.check_registry (verbatim quotes, sections, ids); content reviewed by Claude where noted in review_notes

draft_notes: Only the supplied text was used. The requested prefix contains a carriage return, preserved as \r in requirement IDs. Section numbers follow the printed headings: the trigger subsections restart at 1, 2 and 3, so those numbers also identify provisions outside the earlier sections with identical numbers. Counters remain unique within each section number. The printed subheadings 5.1 and 5.2 are treated as sections. Purpose statements and descriptive framing are not separately registered. External protocols were not supplied. PTL confirmation applies even where an execution order or infrastructure threat supplies the trigger. Immediate intervention and prevention of immediate recurrence coexist with prohibitions on preventive or pre-emptive enforcement; their boundary is undefined. The general requirement for a new identifier on any modification appears qualified by the presentation-only correction exception. The correction clause names a "Last updated" date, while the front matter uses last_updated.

requirements.title: Exclusive Police Function Boundary
requirements.quote: The sole function of police within DKP is to:
requirements.interpretation: Classify each police function against the following closed list: preventing immediate physical harm, enforcing PTL-verified prohibitions, executing decisions already determined by higher layers, and preserving public order without interpreting intent, belief or ideology. The text does not define how mixed-purpose actions are classified.
requirements.criterion: Every police function falls within at least one of the four listed functions and satisfies that function's qualifications.
requirements.gap: The four functions mapped to the police action kinds (H-PA-5); a PTL basis is required for harm prevention.
hypotheses_needed: Define how actions and mixed purposes map to the four permitted functions.

requirements.title: No Foundational Determination Authority
requirements.quote: Police do not define law, policy, justice, guilt, or truth.
requirements.interpretation: Inspect police outputs and authority assignments for determinations defining any listed category. Distinguishing execution of an existing determination from defining one requires a classification of institutional acts.
requirements.criterion: Police do not define law, policy, justice, guilt or truth.
requirements.gap: Observed as fields of police records and refused requests.
hypotheses_needed: Define which institutional acts count as defining each listed category.

requirements.title: Required System Layer Position
requirements.quote: upstream of DKP-4-CRISIS-001 (only for escalation),
requirements.interpretation: Check that policing is downstream of the four listed foundational protocols and upstream of the crisis protocol only for escalation. Downstream and upstream could denote authority precedence, information flow or execution order; the document does not select one.
requirements.criterion: Policing is downstream of DKP-0-ORACLE-001, DKP-1-AXIOMS-001, DKP-1-IDENTITY-001 and DKP-1-IMPACT-001, and upstream of DKP-4-CRISIS-001 only for escalation.
requirements.gap: The operational meaning of the layer relationships is undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Declare whether layer relationships constrain authority, information flow, execution order or a combination.

requirements.title: Applicable Scope Protocol Constraints
requirements.quote: constrained by DKP-7-SCOPE-001.
requirements.interpretation: Evaluate policing against the constraints of the named scope protocol. Those constraints are absent from the supplied document.
requirements.criterion: Policing satisfies DKP-7-SCOPE-001.
requirements.gap: Police action kinds are mapped to SCOPE S0/S1 by a lab list (H-PA-5).

requirements.title: No Normative Authority Creation
requirements.quote:
reinterpret axioms,

define guilt or liability,
requirements.interpretation: Reject police actions that create new norms, reinterpret axioms, or define guilt or liability, as listed under Police SHALL NOT. Checking whether an action has these effects requires a semantic classification.
requirements.criterion: No police action creates new norms, reinterprets axioms, or defines guilt or liability.
requirements.gap: Observed as fields of police records and refused requests.
hypotheses_needed: Define how action effects are classified into the prohibited categories.

requirements.title: PTL Confirmed Operating Conditions
requirements.quote: operate outside PTL-confirmed conditions.
requirements.interpretation: Match each police action to PTL-confirmed conditions under the preceding SHALL NOT. The required match, temporal validity and geographic coverage of confirmation are unspecified.
requirements.criterion: Every police action operates within PTL-confirmed conditions.
data_dependencies: PTL confirmations linked to action conditions
hypotheses_needed: Define the relation between confirmed conditions and the actions they cover.

requirements.title: Temporary Localized Execution Authority
requirements.quote: Police authority is defined as temporary, localized, and execution-only.
requirements.interpretation: Check authority grants for temporal and local limits and for restriction to execution. Neither the permitted duration nor the meaning of localized or execution-only is operationally defined.
requirements.criterion: Every police authority grant is temporary, localized and execution-only.
requirements.gap: Operational definitions of temporary, localized and execution-only are missing. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define acceptable temporal and local boundaries and the execution-only function class.

requirements.title: Conditional Permitted Police Operations
requirements.quote:
physically intervene to stop ongoing or imminent PTL-verified harm,

enforce access restrictions already determined by system protocols,
requirements.interpretation: Apply the qualifications attached to the four permissions: intervention against ongoing or imminent PTL-verified harm, execution of already determined access restrictions, detention under this protocol, and scene security for PTL capture. These permissions remain subject to the document's general trigger and force constraints.
requirements.criterion: An operation invoking one of the four permissions satisfies the qualification attached to that permission.
requirements.gap: Imminence and the classification of operation purposes are not operationally defined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define harm imminence and the evidence needed to classify each operation.

requirements.title: Forbidden Enforcement Bases
requirements.quote:
conduct ideological, moral, or preventive enforcement,

act on suspicion, profiling, or predictive scoring,
requirements.interpretation: Identify whether enforcement has any of the listed prohibited bases. Preventive enforcement is not distinguished from permitted intervention against imminent harm or prevention of immediate recurrence.
requirements.criterion: Police do not conduct ideological, moral or preventive enforcement or act on suspicion, profiling or predictive scoring.
hypotheses_needed: Define prohibited bases and distinguish preventive enforcement from the expressly permitted immediate interventions.

requirements.title: No Interpretation Or Judgments
requirements.quote:
interpret intent, belief, loyalty, or motivation,

issue binding judgments.
requirements.interpretation: Check police reasoning and outputs for interpretation of the listed mental or ideological attributes and for issuance of binding judgments. The text does not define what makes a judgment binding.
requirements.criterion: Police neither interpret intent, belief, loyalty or motivation nor issue binding judgments.
requirements.gap: Observed as fields of police records and refused requests.
hypotheses_needed: Define which recorded reasoning and outputs constitute the prohibited acts.

requirements.title: At Least One Action Trigger
requirements.quote: Police action is permitted only when at least one of the following holds:
requirements.interpretation: Evaluate the disjunction of the three following trigger predicates. This is a necessary condition rather than a complete authorization, since PTL confirmation and other constraints also apply.
requirements.criterion: Police action implies active_physical_harm_trigger OR system_execution_order_trigger OR critical_infrastructure_trigger.
requirements.gap: Triggers 1 and 2; critical-infrastructure threat (3) is not modelled.

requirements.title: Verified Physical Harm Trigger
requirements.quote: Ongoing or imminent physical harm verified by PTL inputs.
requirements.interpretation: The Active Physical Harm trigger requires both ongoing or imminent physical harm and PTL verification. The text supplies no test for imminence or for verification sufficiency.
requirements.criterion: The trigger holds only for PTL-verified physical harm that is ongoing or imminent.
hypotheses_needed: Declare the harm-imminence classifier and PTL verification acceptance rule.

requirements.title: Valid System Execution Order
requirements.quote: A valid enforcement order produced by L2 or L4 protocols.
requirements.interpretation: Check the producing protocol's layer and the enforcement order's validity. L2 and L4 are named as layers without protocol identifiers or order-validation rules.
requirements.criterion: The trigger holds only for a valid enforcement order produced by an L2 or L4 protocol.
hypotheses_needed: Declare the protocol-layer mapping and the rule for validating enforcement orders.

requirements.title: Critical Infrastructure Threat Trigger
requirements.quote: Immediate threat to PTL infrastructure, identity continuity, or essential biospheric systems.
requirements.interpretation: Test for an immediate threat to at least one listed protected category. Threat immediacy and membership in the protected categories require external classifications.
requirements.criterion: The trigger holds only for an immediate threat to PTL infrastructure, identity continuity or essential biospheric systems.
requirements.gap: Immediate threat and essential biospheric systems lack operational definitions. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define immediate threat and the membership rules for protected targets.

requirements.title: Default To Non Intervention
requirements.quote: Absence of PTL confirmation SHALL default to non-intervention.
requirements.interpretation: When confirmation is absent, check that the default decision is non-intervention. The text supplies no override, although the word default does not itself define an exception procedure.
requirements.criterion: If PTL confirmation is absent, the default decision is non-intervention.

requirements.title: Exclusive Temporary Detention Purposes
requirements.quote:
Temporary detention is permitted only to:

stop active harm,
requirements.interpretation: Check that detention serves a listed purpose: stopping active harm, preventing immediate recurrence or ensuring identity attribution. The list can be read as alternative permitted purposes; the text does not specify whether multiple purposes must ever hold together.
requirements.criterion: Temporary detention serves only the purposes of stopping active harm, preventing immediate recurrence or ensuring identity attribution.
requirements.gap: Detention for identity attribution is not modelled.
hypotheses_needed: Treat the listed purposes as alternatives and define evidence for each purpose.

requirements.title: Detention Must Have Time Limit
requirements.quote:
Detention SHALL:

be time-limited,
requirements.interpretation: Check that each detention has a finite applicable time limit and does not exceed it. The text does not provide a maximum duration, a start event or rules for extension.
requirements.criterion: Each detention is subject to and remains within a finite time limit.
requirements.gap: No numeric limit in the corpus: the detention must have an end.
hypotheses_needed: Declare the detention time limit, clock origin and treatment of extensions.

requirements.title: Immutable Detention Log Requirement
requirements.quote: be logged immutably,
requirements.interpretation: Check that each detention produces a log record protected against alteration. The document does not specify a log schema or a technical standard for immutability.
requirements.criterion: Every detention is recorded in an immutable log.
hypotheses_needed: Define an adequate detention record and an accepted immutability mechanism.

requirements.title: Automatic Higher Layer Review
requirements.quote: trigger automatic review by higher layers.
requirements.interpretation: Check that detention automatically initiates review by a higher layer. No review deadline or required review outcome is given.
requirements.criterion: Every detention triggers review automatically by a higher layer.
hypotheses_needed: Define higher-layer eligibility and the observable automatic review trigger.

requirements.title: Forbidden Detention Categories
requirements.quote: Preventive or indefinite detention is forbidden.
requirements.interpretation: Reject detention classified as preventive or indefinite. The preventive category must be reconciled with the explicit permission to prevent immediate recurrence.
requirements.criterion: No detention is preventive or indefinite.
hypotheses_needed: Define preventive detention and distinguish it from immediate-recurrence detention.

requirements.title: Non Forceful Alternatives Condition
requirements.quote:
Use of force is permitted only when:

non-forceful alternatives are unavailable or ineffective,
requirements.interpretation: Check that non-forceful alternatives are unavailable or ineffective before force is permitted. The relevant alternative set and effectiveness test are unspecified.
requirements.criterion: Use of force implies that non-forceful alternatives are unavailable or ineffective.
requirements.gap: Effectiveness of alternatives is declared.
hypotheses_needed: Define the relevant alternatives and their availability and effectiveness tests.

requirements.title: Force Proportionality To Threat
requirements.quote: force is proportional to the verified physical threat,
requirements.interpretation: Compare the force used with the verified physical threat. No scale, ratio or proportionality decision rule is supplied.
requirements.criterion: Force is proportional to the verified physical threat.
requirements.gap: Force and threat on a declared 0-3 scale.
hypotheses_needed: Declare a proportionality model without treating its parameters as document-specified values.

requirements.title: Minimize Irreversible Harm
requirements.quote: action minimizes irreversible harm (Axiom A4).
requirements.interpretation: Compare the action's irreversible harm with relevant alternatives. The text names Axiom A4 but supplies neither its content nor the harm metric and feasible comparison set.
requirements.criterion: An action using force minimizes irreversible harm.
requirements.gap: Axiom A4, an irreversible-harm measure and the comparison set are missing. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define feasible alternatives, irreversible harm and whether minimization uses predicted or realized outcomes.

requirements.title: Exclusive Lethal Force Conditions
requirements.quote: Lethal force is permitted only under Axiom A1 minimum-required conditions, as defined exclusively by DKP-4-CRISIS-001.
requirements.interpretation: Permit lethal force only if the Axiom A1 minimum-required conditions defined by the named crisis protocol are satisfied. The text does not independently define those conditions.
requirements.criterion: Lethal force implies satisfaction of the Axiom A1 minimum-required conditions defined exclusively by DKP-4-CRISIS-001.
requirements.gap: Lethal force without authorization fails; with a declared authorization UNKNOWN (F-023).

requirements.title: Identity Attribution For Actions
requirements.quote: MUST be identity-attributed under DKP-1-IDENTITY-001,
requirements.interpretation: Check that every police action has attribution satisfying the named identity protocol. Merely having an identifier cannot establish compliance without that protocol's requirements.
requirements.criterion: Every police action is identity-attributed under DKP-1-IDENTITY-001.

requirements.title: PTL Logging And Retrospective Audit
requirements.quote:
MUST be PTL-logged,

MUST be auditable post-facto.
requirements.interpretation: Require a PTL log record for every action and sufficient retained evidence for retrospective audit. The text does not specify record contents, retention or audit criteria.
requirements.criterion: Every police action is PTL-logged and auditable after the action.
hypotheses_needed: Define required log evidence and the conditions for retrospective auditability.

requirements.title: Complete Action Responsibility Trace
requirements.quote: Police officers are not sovereign actors. Responsibility for any action is always traceable to:
requirements.interpretation: Trace each action to its executing officer and issuing protocol or authority, and to its originating Subject where applicable. The document does not define when Subject attribution is applicable or whether traceability requires a particular record structure.
requirements.criterion: Every action has traceable responsibility to the executing officer, the issuing protocol or authority, and the originating Subject where applicable.
requirements.gap: Officer and issuing authority; originating Subject not modelled.
hypotheses_needed: Define when an originating Subject is applicable and what evidence establishes each responsibility link.

requirements.title: Predictive Policing And Profiling Ban
requirements.quote:
predictive policing,

profiling based on ideology, religion, culture, or belief,
requirements.interpretation: Check police functions and decision inputs for predictive policing or profiling based on any listed attribute. Operational definitions of prediction and profiling are not supplied.
requirements.criterion: No predictive policing or profiling based on ideology, religion, culture or belief occurs.
requirements.gap: Requests for the two functions are declared.
hypotheses_needed: Define the prohibited function classes and how use of a listed profiling basis is detected.

requirements.title: Morality And Unnecessary Surveillance Ban
requirements.quote:
enforcement of morality or social norms,

surveillance not anchored in PTL necessity,
requirements.interpretation: Reject enforcement of morality or social norms and surveillance lacking a PTL-necessity basis. PTL necessity is not defined and cannot be assumed equivalent to the existence of any PTL observation.
requirements.criterion: No morality or social-norm enforcement occurs, and every surveillance activity is anchored in PTL necessity.
requirements.gap: The boundary of morality or social-norm enforcement and the test for PTL necessity are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define prohibited enforcement grounds and an evidentiary test for PTL necessity.

requirements.title: No Discretionary Authority Expansion
requirements.quote: discretionary expansion of authority.
requirements.interpretation: Compare authority changes with their authorization basis and reject discretionary expansion. The distinction between prohibited discretion and explicitly scoped crisis extension is not operationally defined.
requirements.criterion: No authority expansion is discretionary.
hypotheses_needed: Define discretion and distinguish it from authorized crisis extension.

requirements.title: Critical Integrity Breach Classification
requirements.quote: Violation constitutes a critical integrity breach.
requirements.interpretation: Classify a detected violation of the preceding prohibited functions as a critical integrity breach. The immediate context supports section-local application; the sentence does not explicitly say whether all protocol violations also qualify.
requirements.criterion: A violation of a function prohibition in section 7 is classified as a critical integrity breach.
requirements.gap: Requests for prohibited functions are declared.

requirements.title: Temporary Crisis Authority Extension
requirements.quote:
During a formally declared Crisis under DKP-4-CRISIS-001:

police authority MAY be temporarily extended,
requirements.interpretation: Validate an extension invoking this permission against a formal crisis declaration and a temporary duration. The declaration requirements and the permissible duration or expiry event are not supplied.
requirements.criterion: An extension under this clause occurs during a formally declared Crisis under DKP-4-CRISIS-001 and is temporary.
hypotheses_needed: Define how temporary duration is represented and whether extension authority expires with the crisis.

requirements.title: Explicit Scope For Extensions
requirements.quote: such extension MUST be explicitly scoped,
requirements.interpretation: Check that every crisis authority extension has an explicit scope declaration. The required dimensions and level of detail of that declaration are unspecified.
requirements.criterion: Every crisis authority extension has an explicit scope.
hypotheses_needed: Define the minimum content needed for an explicit scope declaration.

requirements.title: Crisis Actions Create No Precedent
requirements.quote: no crisis action creates precedent.
requirements.interpretation: Check whether a crisis policing action is assigned precedential authority or later used as such. The text does not define precedent or distinguish it from nonbinding historical evidence.
requirements.criterion: No crisis policing action creates precedent.
requirements.gap: Observed as the extension ending with the Crisis.
hypotheses_needed: Define what constitutes creating or assigning precedent.

requirements.title: Scope Constraints Survive Crisis
requirements.quote: All crisis policing actions remain constrained by DKP-7-SCOPE-001.
requirements.interpretation: Apply the scope protocol to every crisis policing action, including actions under extended authority. The content of the surviving constraints is external.
requirements.criterion: Every crisis policing action satisfies DKP-7-SCOPE-001.
requirements.gap: Police action kinds are mapped to SCOPE S0/S1 by a lab list (H-PA-5).

requirements.title: Public Aggregates Preserve Privacy
requirements.quote:
SHALL be publicly auditable in aggregated form,

SHALL preserve individual privacy,
requirements.interpretation: Check that policing statistics are publicly auditable as aggregates while preserving individual privacy. The document supplies no aggregation rule, privacy standard or audit-access specification.
requirements.criterion: All policing statistics are publicly auditable in aggregated form and preserve individual privacy.
hypotheses_needed: Define aggregation, public audit access and privacy tests.

requirements.title: Support Post Incident Reconstruction
requirements.quote: SHALL support post-incident causal reconstruction.
requirements.interpretation: Assess whether policing statistics provide adequate information for causal reconstruction after an incident. The text does not define the causal model, reconstruction method or success criterion.
requirements.criterion: Policing statistics support post-incident causal reconstruction.
requirements.gap: The required reconstruction capability and its evaluation method are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define a causal reconstruction method and the evidence needed for it to succeed.

requirements.title: No Secret Policing Authority
requirements.quote: No secret policing authority is permitted.
requirements.interpretation: Compare actual policing authority with disclosed authority records. The text does not define the audience, disclosure channel or timing needed to make authority nonsecret.
requirements.criterion: No policing authority is secret.
requirements.gap: The disclosure conditions distinguishing secret from nonsecret authority are missing. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define the required disclosure audience, content, channel and timing.

requirements.title: Protected Domains And Judicial Roles
requirements.quote:
regulate belief, speech, or culture,

substitute judicial or justice protocols,
requirements.interpretation: Check protocol provisions and their application for regulation of the listed domains or substitution for judicial or justice protocols. The boundaries of regulation and substitution require interpretation.
requirements.criterion: DKP-3-POLICE-001 does not regulate belief, speech or culture or substitute judicial or justice protocols.
requirements.gap: Observed through declared requests; long-term punishment and exit rights are separate provisions.
hypotheses_needed: Define regulation and substitution using observable institutional effects.

requirements.title: Punishment And Continuity Scope Limits
requirements.quote:
define long-term punishment or rehabilitation,

override exit rights or identity continuity.
requirements.interpretation: Reject protocol provisions or applications that define long-term punishment or rehabilitation or override either listed protection. Long-term, exit rights and identity continuity are not defined here.
requirements.criterion: DKP-3-POLICE-001 does not define long-term punishment or rehabilitation or override exit rights or identity continuity.
requirements.gap: The protected rights, continuity conditions and meaning of long-term are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define long-term, exit rights, identity continuity and the effects constituting an override.

requirements.title: Controlled Protocol Change Procedure
requirements.quote: This protocol is changed only through the controlled procedure of DKP-4-UPGRADE-001: proposal, simulation under DKP-8-SIMULATION-001, audit under DKP-8-AUDIT-001, acceptance conditions, activation window and rollback.
requirements.interpretation: Check changes against the named upgrade procedure and its listed components, subject to the presentation-only exception below. The clause requires rollback within the procedure but does not establish that every change must actually be rolled back.
requirements.criterion: A protocol change follows DKP-4-UPGRADE-001, including the listed proposal, simulation, audit, acceptance, activation-window and rollback components.
requirements.gap: Declared stages of the change; the procedure itself is upgrade_lifecycle.

requirements.title: New Identifier For Modifications
requirements.quote: any modification requires a new protocol identifier,
requirements.interpretation: Check that a modification receives a new protocol identifier. Read with the final sentence, presentation-only corrections appear exempt; a literal reading of any modification would instead include them.
requirements.criterion: A modification subject to this clause receives a new protocol identifier.
hypotheses_needed: Treat qualifying presentation-only corrections as exempt and define the applicable identifier namespace.

requirements.title: Mandatory Simulation Of Modifications
requirements.quote: mandatory simulation under DKP-8-SIMULATION-001,
requirements.interpretation: Require simulation for modifications governed by the upgrade rules and validate it under the named simulation protocol. The content and success requirements of that protocol are absent.
requirements.criterion: Every modification subject to the upgrade rules undergoes simulation under DKP-8-SIMULATION-001.
requirements.gap: Simulation results are declared.
hypotheses_needed: Treat qualifying presentation-only corrections as exempt from the modification simulation requirement.

requirements.title: Explicit Protocol Compatibility Declaration
requirements.quote: explicit compatibility declaration with DKP-1-AXIOMS-001 and DKP-7-SCOPE-001.
requirements.interpretation: Check that a modification requiring upgrade treatment includes an explicit declaration of compatibility with both named protocols. This provision requires the declaration; its presence alone does not establish substantive compatibility.
requirements.criterion: Every modification subject to upgrade treatment includes an explicit compatibility declaration naming DKP-1-AXIOMS-001 and DKP-7-SCOPE-001.

requirements.title: Presentation Correction Exception And Record
requirements.quote: Presentation-only corrections that do not change normative content are not Upgrades (DKP-4-UPGRADE-001 §3); they are recorded only by the "Last updated" date of this document.
requirements.interpretation: Classify a correction as outside Upgrades only when it is presentation-only and leaves normative content unchanged, then check that its change record consists only of the document's Last updated date. The text does not provide a semantic equivalence test or specify how this label maps to the last_updated front-matter field.
requirements.criterion: A presentation-only correction with unchanged normative content is not an Upgrade and is recorded only by the document's Last updated date.
hypotheses_needed: Define a normative-content equivalence test and map Last updated to the document's date field.
